containerDefinitions.name: intel-api-oneoff
entryPoint: ENCODED_PASSWORD=*** -e 'process.stdout.write(encodeURIComponent(process.argv[1]))' "$DB_PASSWORD"); export DATABASE_URL="postgresql://${DB_USER}:***@${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/${DB_NAME}?schema=public&sslmode=require"; node -e "const{PrismaClient}=require("./generated/prisma-client");(async()=>{const p=new PrismaClient();try{const r=await p.\$queryRawUnsafe('select id, slug from tenants where slug=\$1',"capiro-internal");console.log("TENANT_ROW="+JSON.stringify(r));if(r&&r[0]&&r[0].id){const tid=r[0].id;await p.\$executeRawUnsafe('insert into intel_feature_flag (id, feature, tenant_id, enabled, created_at) values (\$1,\$2,\$3,true,now()) on conflict (feature, tenant_id) do update set enabled=true',"ff_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),"hearing_watch",tid);console.log("FLAG_SEEDED for "+tid);}else{console.log("NO_TENANT_FOUND");}}catch(err){console.error("QERR="+err.message);process.exit(1);}finally{await p.\$disconnect();}})()"
